chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
It would suffice you in the Qunut (to say): 'O Allah! Forgive us, and have mercy on us, and grant us health, and pardon us in the world and the Hereafter. You are Able over everything.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite during the Qunut of prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a concise, comprehensive supplication that suffices for the Qunut, reflecting the Shia emphasis on brevity and depth in voluntary prayers. It underscores the holistic nature of divine petition, linking worldly well-being with eternal salvation, a theme central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the flexibility of Qunut recitations.
